messages:
maya: Heads-up — we have an urgent enterprise commit for APAC (fintech customer). They need ~40 A100-equivalent GPUs by 2026-05-28. Our marketplace reservation with OrionCloud is showing ETA 2026-06-04. Can we escalate/exception this allocation? :pray:

sam: Do we have the reservation id? Marketplace rules usually need 14d lead time for priority reassignments. If it was reserved as 'standard' we may be blocked. Share reservation number and PO.

maya: Reservation ID 987654321, PO 2026-AP-9001. It was reserved under a sales-assisted commit last month (mentioned in the contract appendix). Customer is pushing go-live and will churn if we miss the date.

liam: Quick ops note — SG customs has had a backlog last week; shipments cleared in 2-6 days. If we can reroute to JP or KR it's usually faster (1-2 days). But re-routing adds carrier cost and may need partner signoff.

jin: Hey team (OrionCloud logistics) — saw the reservation. We have a partial prod hold for that SKU for EU allocation. We can do a split: 20 units ship from our SG pool next-week via express air, remaining 20 from EU by sea (ETA early June). Express air adds ~22% cost and requires export docs update.

maya: That's promising. Is there an ability to bump APAC priority so the marketplace automated allocator moves more slots from EU -> APAC?

jin: We can request a marketplace priority-exception but it needs approvals from our channel manager. I can do the partner-side request now. On your side we need a signed amendment to the reservation (one-line) to confirm acceptance of split shipment and extra freight.

sarah: From sales POV — customer will accept a split if we guarantee first 20 online by 05-28 and SLA credit if final 20 delayed. Need to confirm cost absorption: do we eat the air freight or pass to customer?

sam: Two options: 1) we absorb air cost for NRR (retain customer) and charge a one-time platform credit for the shipping delta, or 2) split cost with customer (not ideal). Need finance approval; pinging @finance now.

deploy-bot: Reservation 987654321 status changed -> PARTIAL_ALLOCATED by OrionCloud (20 allocated to apac-pool).

liam: To speed infra preparation we should start subnet / firewall pre-provisioning for the 20 nodes expected in SG. I'll open a request with eng-infra: ticket INF-4291.

maya: Jin — if partner can confirm express air pickup by 05-24 (arrive 05-27), we can hit the date. Please escalate to channel manager. Also need updated ETA + airwaybill once shipped.

jin: Escalated. Channel manager approved conditional exception pending signed amendment and ship cost decision. ETA email to follow.

sam: Ops/legal note — amendment should be a short email doc saying: `OrionCloud will ship 20 units via express air to APAC pool by 2026-05-24. Redwood will accept split shipment and cover freight delta.` Legal wants to review before signing.

maya: Ok — I'll draft amendment and loop legal. Can someone confirm the exact freight delta estimate?

jin: Rough estimate for 20 GPUs: +$18,500 USD. I'll get a formal quote from carrier today.

sarah: If we absorb $18.5k, it's cheaper than losing the customer. I'll update customer terms (informal) to get their buy-in.

maya: Draft amendment posted here for review (internal):

```
Amendment: Redwood and OrionCloud agree to split shipment for Reservation 987654321. OrionCloud to ship 20 units via express air to APAC pool no later than 2026-05-24. Redwood acknowledges split delivery and will accept provisional allocation for go-live. Redwood will decide on freight cost absorption within 24 hours of OrionCloud carrier quote.
```

liam: Typo: change "no later than 2026-05-24" -> "pickup by 2026-05-24" (arrival target 2026-05-27).

maya: Good catch — fixed.

sam: Finance responded: we can approve up to $20k one-time contingency for high-severity retention. Please attach customer risk note and sign-off from Sales.

sarah: Attached risk note in Confluence and sales sign-off in thread. Customer verbally confirmed they'd accept split and will wait for first 20 online.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4291 created (eng-infra) — assign: liam, due: 2026-05-26.

jin: Carrier formal quote received: $18,120. Airwaybill will be provided on shipment. Channel manager finalized exception -> priority granted for 20 units to apac-pool.

maya: Great. Next steps: 1) legal review + sign amendment (maya), 2) finance confirm payment path for $18,120 (sam), 3) infra prep (liam), 4) partner to ship and provide AWB (jin). I'll mark this P0 and update execs. :shipit:

sam: Executed command to transfer reserved slots (internal tool):
```
reservationctl transfer --from=eu_pool --to=apac_pool --reservation=987654321 --count=20 --reason="apac-enterprise-commit"
```

deploy-bot: reservationctl: transfer accepted -> job 7731 (in progress).

jin: AWB 860-44321 will be sent once pickup completes. Expect pickup 2026-05-24.

maya: Closing loop — legal signed amendment at 2026-05-22T18:03Z, finance approved charge path, infra prepping. Thanks everyone. Will post final shipment AWB when we have it. :eyes:
